findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Inspector observed the silicone sealant (caulking) to be damaged or inadequate around the hot line units and counter to the left of the dish machine. Ensure these areas are repaired prior to the next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices.
findings.comment: The inspector observed a small freshwater leak at the mop sink as well as a leak at the dish area hand sink. The PIC was informed and maintenance will be scheduled for the plumbing concerns. Ensure these repairs are completed prior to the next routine inspection (at least 90 days).
findings.citation_text: 5-205.15(B) System Maintained in Good Repair. A plumbing system shall be: (B) Maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.comment:
Repeat Violation

Observed employee fail to use a barrier to turn off the hand sink after washing hands. PIC was informed that a barrier such as a paper towel should be used to turn off the hand sink to prevent cross-contamination. Ensure all staff members are properly hand washing at all times.
findings.citation_text: 2-301.12(C) Cleaning Procedure. (C) To avoid recontaminating their hands or surrogate prosthetic devices, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use disposable paper towels or similar clean barriers when touching surfaces such as manually operated faucet handles on a HANDWASHING SINK or the handle of a restroom door.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.comment: Inspector observed an employee fail to wash their hands before donning new gloves to portion food for the dessert bar. The PIC was informed and education was conducted regarding proper handwashing. Ensure staff are washing their hands before putting on new gloves to prevent cross-contamination.
findings.citation_text: 2-301.14 When to Wash. FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms as specified under § 2-301.12 immediately before engaging in FOOD preparation including working with exposed FOOD, clean EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS, and unwrapped SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES and: (A) After touching bare human body parts other than clean hands and clean, exposed portions of arms; (B) After using the toilet room; (C) After caring for or handling SERVICE ANIMALS or aquatic animals as specified in 2-403.11(B); (D) Except as specified in 2-401.11(B), after coughing, sneezing, using a handkerchief or disposable tissue, using TOBACCO PRODUCTS, eating, or drinking; (E) After handling soiled EQUIPMENT or UTENSILS; (F) During FOOD preparation, as often as necessary to remove soil and contamination and to prevent cross contamination when changing tasks; (G) When switching between working with raw FOOD and working with READY-TO-EAT FOOD; (H) Before donning gloves to initiate a task that involves working with FOOD; and (I) After engaging in other activities that contaminate the hands.

findings.title: Utensils, equipment, and linens: properly stored, dried, and handled.
findings.comment: Inspector observed knives and a pair of scissors stored inside of counters or equipment which is not considered easily cleanable. Ensure utensils are stored in designated areas to avoid contamination. The PIC was informed and the utensils were sent to the dish area.
findings.citation_text: 4-903.12(A)(1) and A(3)-(8) Prohibitions. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, cleaned and SANITIZED EQUIPMENT, UTENSILS, laundered LINENS, and SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES may not be stored: (1) In locker rooms; (3) In garbage rooms; (4) In mechanical rooms; (5) Under sewer lines that are not shielded to intercept potential drips; (6) Under leaking water lines including leaking automatic fire sprinkler heads or under lines on which water has condensed; (7) Under open stairwells; or (8) Under other sources of contamination.

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices.
findings.comment: Inspector observed the triple sink in the dish washing area to be leaking from the drainage plumbing. PIC was informed that waste water must be properly conveyed and plumbing must be maintained in good repair. A follow-up will be conducted on July 24, 2025 to ensure the plumbing has been repaired.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.15(A) System Maintained in Good Repair. A plumbing system shall be: (A) Repaired according to LAW.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment:
Repeat Violation

Observed hand sink in server area to have ice in sink basin. PIC was informed that hand sinks are not to be used for any purpose other than hand washing. Ensure staff are using at dump sink to empty drink glasses rather than the hand sinks.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.11 Using a Handwashing Sink. (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices.
findings.comment: Observed tap in kitchen for pressure washer to be leaking. The leak was a steady drip onto the floor. The hand sink in the server area has is also leaking into the sink basin. Ensure plumbing is in good repair at all times. A follow-up will be conducted on 3/27/2025 to ensure the plumbing issues have been repaired.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.15(A) System Maintained in Good Repair. A plumbing system shall be: (A) Repaired according to LAW.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
Observed sprayer from spray bottle in basin of bakery hand washing sink. Sprayer was removed during inspection. 

5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.
